name: Treasure Chest
description: A small iron-banded chest, its lock long rusted through.

name: Adventurer's Satchel
description: A worn leather bag left behind by someone who didn't make it out.

name: Alchemist's Crate
description: Straw-packed bottles, most of them still intact.

name: Temple Offering Box
description: Coins and a blessed flask, given by the faithful.

name: Dragon's Hoard (small)
description: A glittering heap. Only a fraction of it fits in your pack.

name: Quartermaster's Chest
description: Army stores, stamped with a long-forgotten crest.
